pr_title: Enable custom separators to treat different characters as words
pr_body:
Implements proposal written here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/9837, including comment https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/9837#issuecomment-2136118971


Adds two options in Editor Settings to treat custom defined words as word delimiters/separators. If the first option is enabled, it uses the list below to stop caret on these characters to ease subword movement as in VSCode and some other editors.

![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/231068/f216ce3e-bf37-4350-a433-124e85fb5655)


Uses #46721, fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/5731 and closes #69254 and closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/91964

The functionality is disabled by default.

issue_context.title: Double clicking on variable names followed by assignment or compare operators,  includes the right side value
issue_context.body:
### Tested versions

v4.3.dev6.official [64520fe67]

### System information

Linux Kubuntu 23.04 KDE Plasma Version: 5.27.4 KDE Frameworks Version: 5.104.0 Qt Version: 5.15.8

### Issue description

In Dev 6, Double clicking on variable names followed by assignment or compare operators,  includes the right side value.
if there is no space separator between them/
Works correctly in dev 5

### Steps to reproduce

Example screen shots
Double click on str highlights past the assignment
![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/930478/0068b239-8657-496a-83f1-734caadfc92d)

Double click on major highlights past the compare
![image](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/930478/fa5f396a-1b7c-4b46-b9c0-9c8da3fb4958)


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

see screen shots
comments: CC @kitbdev - didn't bisect but I suspect it could be one of your TextEdit changes.

I think it was caused by:
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/90732

Apparently a virtual space grapheme was used to separate them, but virtual graphemes are now skipped. It also isn't considered punctuation.

- Related https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/69254

Heya wanted to add that this happens if you click on the right hand value as well. 

E.g.
`code=0123
`
So if you click on **0123** it will also highlight **code**

How much code was changed to cause this issue? I guess I am just saying maybe revert back this particular issue for now, so we can keep testing 6 without much fuss.
I hope this makes it through into the beta. It's PITA trying to write code.
